description:
Senior Product Designer at Corvidae

Corvidae is a 22-person team building reading tools for researchers. We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to own the reader surface — the page our users stare at for hours each day.

You will
- Design the reading canvas, annotation layer, and citation network view. These are our hardest surfaces.
- Run weekly sessions with 3-5 researchers. Hold the thread between what they ask for and what they actually need.
- Partner with a lead engineer (shipping together, not relay-race handoffs). Prototype in Figma, then in code where it matters.
- Maintain and evolve our design system. Document the hard calls.

What we care about
- 6+ years of product design. At least 2 roles where you owned a surface end-to-end.
- Taste you can articulate. We want to hear why you cut a feature, not just what you shipped.
- Comfortable with typography, long-form text rendering, reader behavior.
- Figma fluency is assumed. Prototyping in HTML/CSS is a plus.
- Written communication — you'll be writing a lot of design memos.

Not required but a bonus
- Academic background or proximity to research communities.
- Experience with design systems at 2+ companies.
